data.name: Tavern Tycoon: Brew & Brawl
data.detailed_description:
From Captives to Keepers — Begin Your Tavern Legacy

In Tavern Tycoon: Brew & Brawl, your journey begins in chains.

Experience a fully illustrated interactive visual novel prologue that sets the stage—follow a gripping tale of escape, betrayal, and newfound camaraderie as you choose between a male or female protagonist. Once the story unfolds, seamlessly transition into a vibrant top-down 3D tavern management adventure, where your choices shape the future of your inn, your crew, and your corner of the realm.

Core Gameplay Features

  • Visual Novel Prologue

    Start with an emotionally rich, choice-driven visual novel that introduces the world, your character, and the companions you'll come to rely on.

  • Escape & Reclaim

    Break free from your captors, survive the wilds, and reclaim a forgotten hideout as your base of operations.

  • Rebuild the Tavern

    Transform your hideout into a legendary tavern. Upgrade facilities, decorate with flair, and expand into new zones that attract diverse adventurers.

  • Play Your Protagonist
    Choose your hero—male or female—and unlock story moments and interactions unique to your path.

  • Serve, Host, Survive
    Manage staff, satisfy patrons, and throw unforgettable events—but beware, not every guest comes with gold and good intentions.

  •  Defend the Tavern
    Goblins, thieves, and monsters are drawn to your fame. Build defenses, hire bouncers, and protect your home from nightly threats.

  • Rise to Legendary Status
    Upgrade gear, train staff, uncover secrets, and take your tavern from humble beginnings to a cornerstone of the realm.

data.short_description: Run and defend your own fantasy tavern in this cozy simulation brawler. Manage staff, serve adventurers, and customize your tavern’s layout, then fight off rowdy goblins and bandits with your companion in chaotic barroom brawls.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 ( 64-bit )
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I5-8400 or AMD RYZEN 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GEFORCE GTX 1070 8 GB or AMD RADEON RX VEGA 56 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 Pro ( 64-bit )
  • Processor: 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700HX 2.10 GHz
  • Memory: 16.0 GB RAM
  • Graphics: MSI 2560 x 1600, 240 Hz
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 18 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Any reasonable new Linux distro from CentOS 7.x and up
  • Processor: kernel 3.x or newer
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: glibc 2.17 or newer
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 2080
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
